test_obligations.purpose: Prove that a Frank-owned PerceptualEmbeddingHandle cannot alias mutable/freed libmtmd storage.
cases: context output pointer followed by same-context encode with different media token geometry
batch chunk embedding view followed by batch free/reset
concurrent MVC read versus next media encode
slot/session reset while a perceptual consumer still holds a handle
test_obligations.reference_variant: COPY_ON_CAPTURE immutable Frank-owned embedding buffer with content hash and compatibility identity
test_obligations.optimization_variant: PINNED_RUNTIME_BUFFER only behind explicit ownership fence and exact runtime-version lifetime receipt
hard_failures: stale handle accepted after owner destruction or next encode
process pointer serialized as durable evidence
prototype or re-entry use after compatibility invalidation

test_obligations.purpose: Test the cheapest calibrated geometry ladder before adding a second heavy encoder.
variants: Q2_DUALVIEW only if Q0/Q1 miss the preregistered gate
controls: same runtime and sensor inputs where applicable
test_obligations.decision_rule: Select by end-to-end selective-risk plus latency/resource Pareto frontier. Raw-feature failure alone does not justify a heavy second backbone; Q1 and light-encoder baselines must be measured.
